item.title: Long-time military surplus store to close in Wilmington
item.description: A long-time military surplus store in Wilmington is preparing to close its doors.

item.title: Novant Health announces opening of Scotts Hill Medical Center
item.description: During a New Hanover County Commissioners meeting on Monday, Novant Health provided a five-year outlook which included details on its Scotts Hill Medical Center.

item.title: NHCO commissioners approve $1M agreement for new $9M public park
item.description: On Monday, New Hanover County commissioners committed $1 million to help buy land for a new public park in Wilmington.

item.title: Ashley girls soccer begins practice, determined to finish the job
item.description: Monday marks the beginning of high school spring sports practices, including for Ashley girls soccer.

item.title: 3 killed, including suspect, in shooting during Rhode Island youth hockey game
item.description: Three people, including the suspect, were fatally shot during a Rhode Island youth hockey game Monday, authorities said.

item.title: Carolina Hurricanes reach 3-year extension with goaltender Brandon Bussi through 2028-29 season
item.description: The Carolina Hurricanes have signed goaltender Brandon Bussi to a three-year, $5.7 million extension, keeping the one-time waiver pickup in place through the 2028-29 season.

item.title: From antitrust fight to victory lane: Michael Jordan’s 23XI grabs a Daytona 500 win
item.description: Michael Jordan inherited the racing bug from his late father, who routinely packed everyone into the car and drove from North Carolina to a handful of tracks every year as attending NASCAR races became Jordan family vacations.

item.title: Expectations are low for the latest US-brokered talks between Russia and Ukraine
item.description: A Ukrainian delegation was heading to Geneva on Monday for another round of U.S.-brokered talks with Russian officials, ahead of next week’s fourth anniversary of Russia’s full-scale invasion of its neighbor.

item.title: Opening of Central Pender Park delayed due to utility issue, completion date not known
item.description: Located off Highway 117, Central Pender Park was originally scheduled to open on January 23rd.

item.title: Brunswick County Commissioners hear update on future of in-county fire services
item.description: A couple of ideas being considered include implementing a fire tax, rather than a fire fee, or using $10 million or more from the county's general fund on a one-time basis.
